question: Does the Dysts LISTA-SB row retain its forecasting benefit when it uses one learned LISTA refinement, exactly matching LISTA and LISTA-BD?
motivation: The historical LISTA-SB row used two refinements while LISTA and LISTA-BD used one. This full replacement row removes refinement depth as a confound.

unchanged: native Dysts train/validation/test caches and dt multiplier 30
100000 optimizer steps, batch 256, latent size 256, sequence length 10
LISTA alpha 0.15, sign-split output, sparsity loss 0.006
dense global K with soft-block regularization using the listed diagnostic structure count
learning rates, weight decay, initialization, and all evaluation horizons
matched_contract.fairness_note: This matches learned-refinement count. Sign splitting and soft-block regularization remain the defining LISTA-SB treatment.

evaluation.physical_time: system-specific stored dt times horizon; dt is 30 times the native benchmark step
evaluation.primary_reporting: Use the frozen paper aggregation at H100, H2000, and H4000 and report all system-level paired seed distributions.
evaluation.inference_unit: System is the top-level generalization unit; model seeds are repeated fits nested within system.

interpretation.success: One-refinement LISTA-SB preserves or improves the historical aggregate and remains better than the dense tanh baseline on the predeclared horizons without broad system reversals.
interpretation.failure: A material loss relative to the historical two-refinement row identifies depth as part of the treatment; the replacement must be reported rather than silently mixing rows.
interpretation.ambiguity: If the aggregate improves but several systems reverse, report heterogeneity and avoid a universal claim.

hardware.gpu: one L40S-class GPU per packed array element
hardware.packing: Twelve concurrent fits share one L40S allocation after an exact 12-fit smoke reached sustained 99% utilization with about 7 GiB peak aggregate memory.
hardware.telemetry: Each fit records GPU utilization; packing concurrency is recorded in the queue manifest.
